title: Monster Mash Dance Party & Fundraiser
description: The Northeast Ursamen open Spooky Bear a day early with a Wednesday-night Monster Mash dance party and fundraiser at the Boatslip. It is the only Wednesday item on the official 2026 schedule. Tickets are sold through the Ursamen's Zeffy page (subtitled 'A Night of Classic Frights').
notes: Official Ursamen schedule graphic lists 7:00 PM start with no end time; Out x Out shows 7–10 PM but admits no end time is published. Zeffy ticket page is JS-gated (403) so price unknown. Not listed on the Boatslip's own Elfsight calendar.

title: Solid Gold Tea – Spooky Bear Weekend
description: Thursday's kickoff tea dance on the Boatslip deck is the venue's disco-revival format: classic 70s and 80s dance hits remixed and replayed by resident DJ Maryalice, billed as 'Studio 54 meets Boogie Nights.' Listed on the Boatslip's own calendar as the Spooky Bear Weekend edition.
dressCode: Sequins, satin, big hair, bell-bottoms, bold accessories — disco chic, gold dresses or flashy jumpsuits
notes: Pulled from the Boatslip's Elfsight events-calendar data (widget 588829d7). No cover price published anywhere.

title: Halloween Uniform Tea – Spooky Bear Weekend
description: Friday's tea dance is the Boatslip's uniform-themed Dog Tag Tea dressed up for Halloween: 'We love a man in uniform.' Guests get a souvenir dog tag at the door and DJ Maryalice plays the deck. The Boatslip's listing says 'Extended Hours!' though its calendar entry still shows 4–7 PM.
dressCode: Camo, combat cool, or dog tag chic
notes: Description text mentions extended hours but calendar end time is 19:00; verify on the day. ptownie lists it simply as 'Dog Tag Tea' 4–7 PM.

title: Saints & Sinners Party
description: The Northeast Ursamen's official Friday-night party at the Boatslip, running late after the Crown's Motherdisco starts. It follows the weekend's Roaring Twenties theme. Listed on the official Ursamen schedule and Out x Out but not on the Boatslip's own calendar.
notes: No ticket link found on ursamen.org for this party (only Monster Mash and Bingo have Zeffy links), so it may be door-cover or free; unconfirmed.

title: Spooky Bear Marketplace
description: Halloween-morning vendor market at the Boatslip featuring bear-community makers and merchants. A recurring Spooky Bear fixture (prior years had roughly a dozen vendors with free entry), scheduled on the official 2026 Ursamen program.
notes: Entry fee not stated for 2026; 2023 coverage described free entry.

title: Spooky Tea – Spooky Bear Weekend
description: The Boatslip calls this Spooky Bear Weekend's biggest tea dance, with special extended hours from 4 to 9 PM, 'time enough for a couple of costume changes.' It is the Halloween-day costume tea on the harbor deck before the Crown's costume ball.
dressCode: Halloween costume ('It's Halloween. You know what to do.')
notes: Some third-party listings (gaytravel4u) say 4–7 PM; the venue's own calendar says 4–9 PM.

title: Solid Gold Tea – Spooky Bear Weekend (Sunday closer)
description: Sunday's send-off tea at the Boatslip returns to the Solid Gold disco format with DJ Maryalice spinning remixed 70s and 80s hits. It closes out Spooky Bear weekend on the deck.
dressCode: Sequins, satin, gold, bell-bottoms, big hair
notes: Not the season finale: Boatslip calendar shows teas Nov 6–7 and 'The Very Last Dance 2026' on Nov 8.

title: Qya Cristál & The Bart Weisman Trio: Spooky Bear Live Music
description: Wednesday pre-weekend set in the Crown's Restaurant & Courtyard: Qya Cristál sings Halloween-flavored jazz backed by the Bart Weisman Trio. Dinner and cocktails available; no cover.
notes: Room: Restaurant & Courtyard (Central House).

title: Carve Me Daddy: Pumpkin Carving Party
description: Thursday-evening pumpkin carving party in the Crown's Restaurant & Courtyard with live music, food specials and cocktails. Pumpkins and carving supplies are provided first come, first served while they last.

title: Wave of Terror: Spooky Bear Video Night with VJ Tom Yaz
description: Halloween music-video night in the Wave Bar with VJ Tom Yaz mixing spooky pop favorites and campy Halloween classics. A free hangout before or after FAT SLUT upstairs.

title: FAT SLUT – Spooky Bear (Meatball)
price: $22.42 Early Slut (limited) / $27.69 Late Slut, fees included
description: LA drag star Meatball brings her hit party FAT SLUT to Provincetown for Spooky Bear's opening night in the Paramount. Expect drag shows with a special guest, go-go dancers, a dance party and the party's signature food-eating competition.
notes: All sales final/non-refundable per Tryst.

title: HalloQueen Burner Brunch with Tina Burner – 10:30 AM seating
description: Drag Race All Star Tina Burner hosts a Halloween drag brunch in the Crown's Restaurant & Courtyard: live performances, comedy and camp with brunch and cocktails ordered separately. Doors 10:30 AM, show 11:00 AM. Costumes encouraged.
notes: Listed on the official Ursamen schedule.

title: HalloQueen Burner Brunch with Tina Burner – 1 PM seating
description: Second seating of Tina Burner's Halloween drag brunch in the Crown's Restaurant & Courtyard. Same show format as the 10:30 seating, with food and drinks sold separately.
notes: Price assumed same as the 10:30 seating ($27.69); the 1 PM ticket page itself was not fetched.

title: Ursamen Meet & Greet
description: Friday-evening social hour in the Crown's Wave Bar where attendees can meet the Northeast Ursamen board and other Spooky Bear visitors. On the official 2026 schedule; no ticket link is given.
notes: Almost certainly free (no ticket link), but not stated.

title: Sirens: Live Music – Spooky Bear
description: Halloween edition of the Crown's sapphic live-music night in the Restaurant & Courtyard, featuring vocalists Marissa, Darlene and Lily Mae. No cover.

title: Witch Perfect (Oct 30)
description: A live-singing comedy parody of Hocus Pocus starring Tina Burner (Winifred), Scarlet Envy (Sara) and Alexis Michelle (Mary). The show mixes pop hits from Gaga, Madonna and Cher with Disney and Broadway numbers. Doors 6:30 PM.
notes: Tryst ticket page showed no price tiers (reserved seating; may need JS or be sold out).

title: The Vault – Spooky Bear (Friday)
description: Spooky Bear weekend takeover of the Vault, the Crown's leather bar, with DJ Chris Racine: 'leather, bears, beats and late-night fun.' The page bills it as a multi-night run over the weekend.
notes: Page text says Oct 30 – Nov 1 (three nights) but the Crown calendar only lists Oct 30 and Oct 31 occurrences; Nov 1 unconfirmed. Cover not stated.

title: Mixtape: James Jackson Jr. Piano Night – Halloween Edition
description: Halloween edition of James Jackson Jr.'s Mixtape piano night in the Crown's Restaurant & Courtyard: throwback hits, Broadway classics and pop anthems with Halloween surprises. Costumes encouraged, no cover.

title: Motherdisco: Dead Disco Prom – Spooky Bear
description: NYC party Motherdisco returns to Provincetown for a Spooky Bear takeover themed 'Dead Disco Prom,' promising disco, house and queer nightlife favorites with spooky glamour. Dressing up is encouraged. Friday night's headline dance party at the Crown.
notes: Room not stated on the Crown page (likely Paramount, unconfirmed). DJs not listed.

title: Crown Ghouls: Drag Halloween Brunch – 10:30 AM seating
price: $27.69 incl. fees; $25 food & beverage minimum per person
description: Halloween-morning version of the Crown Jewels all-singing, all-dancing drag brunch, starring Delta Miles, Roxy Pops and Qya Cristál in the Restaurant & Courtyard. Doors 10:30 AM, show 11:00 AM; Halloween attire encouraged. Tickets exclude food and drink.

title: Crown Ghouls: Drag Halloween Brunch – 1 PM seating
price: $27.69 incl. fees; $25 food & beverage minimum per person
description: Second seating of the Crown Ghouls Halloween drag brunch with Delta Miles, Roxy Pops and Qya Cristál. Same format as the 10:30 seating; food and drink sold separately with a $25 minimum.
notes: Price assumed same as 10:30 seating; 1 PM ticket page not fetched directly.

title: Spooky Bear Drag Bingo for a Cause
description: The Ursamen's annual Halloween-afternoon drag bingo in the Paramount Room, hosted by Austin, Morgana De Lux and Felicity V. Lay. Doors open 1:30 PM. This year's beneficiary is the Provincetown Firehouse.
notes: Zeffy page is JS-gated (403), so ticket price unknown. Not on the Crown's own calendar; confirmed via Ursamen flyer.

title: Rest in Piano: Spooky Bear Piano Lounge with Lily Mae
description: Early-evening Halloween piano lounge in the Crown's Restaurant & Courtyard with Lily Mae on vocals and piano: sing-along classics and haunting favorites over cocktails. No cover.

title: Witch Perfect (Oct 31)
description: Halloween-night performance of the live-singing Hocus Pocus parody with Tina Burner, Scarlet Envy and Alexis Michelle as the Sanderson sisters. Doors 6:30 PM, show 7:00 PM, ending in time for the costume ball.
notes: Price not shown on Tryst (reserved seating page).

title: Drop Dead to the Grave: Live Music – Spooky Bear
description: Halloween cabaret in the Crown's Restaurant & Courtyard hosted by Jarvis Derrell with Alexander Zenoz, the Birds of Paradise, a live band and special guests. Costumes encouraged; no cover.

title: The Vault – Spooky Bear (Halloween night)
description: Halloween-night edition of the Vault's Spooky Bear run with DJ Chris Racine in the Crown's leather bar. Runs alongside the Death Becomes Them costume ball in the same complex.
notes: Cover not stated.

title: Death Becomes Them: A Roaring Twenties Halloween Costume Ball
description: The official Spooky Bear 2026 Halloween costume ball, themed Roaring Twenties, with performances by Jan Sport and Tina Burner and music by DJ Jake Glass with VJ Tom Yaz. A costume contest awards a $500 grand prize. Presented with the Northeast Ursamen.
dressCode: Roaring Twenties Halloween costume; dress to impress for the contest
notes: Room not stated (likely Paramount, unconfirmed). Alternate flyer: https://static.wixstatic.com/media/bc384a_e85e8a27e92842e692e92c5f04bb50a5~mv2.jpg

title: Tryster Act: Brunch of the Dead – 10:30 AM seating
price: $27.69 incl. fees; $25 minimum spend (food/drink not included)
description: Spooky Bear edition of the Crown's Sunday 'Tryster Act: A Not So Holy Brunch' with Jan Sport, Tina Burner, Jackie Cox and Jarvis Derrell: live vocals, comedy, sing-alongs and a 'confess your sins' segment. Doors 10:30 AM, show 11:00 AM; gourmet buffet and cocktails sold separately.

title: Tryster Act: Brunch of the Dead – 1 PM seating
price: $27.69 incl. fees; $25 minimum spend (food/drink not included)
description: Second seating of the Spooky Bear Sunday drag brunch with Jan Sport, Tina Burner, Jackie Cox and Jarvis Derrell. Same show and pricing structure as the 10:30 seating.
notes: Price assumed same as 10:30 seating; 1 PM ticket page not fetched directly.

title: Scarlett Strauss' Booo-b Bash (benefit)
description: Sunday-night drag benefit in the Paramount hosted by Tina Burner and Mackenzie, with Tammie Brown, Jackie Cox, Marissa Miller, Britanny Rolfs, Lakia Mondale, Raquel Blake, Alexis Michelle, Scarlet Envy and others. Raises funds for performer Scarlett Strauss. Doors 8 PM.
notes: Listed end time 9 PM may just be the show slot; donations also via Venmo @ScarlettStrauss.

title: Spooky Bear Early Bear Meet Up
description: The Ursamen's casual Thursday-night welcome gathering at the Gifford House's Porch Bar, for early arrivals before FAT SLUT at the Crown. On the official 2026 schedule.
notes: 'Free' per Out x Out listing.

title: 4th Annual Townie Masquerade Ball
description: Fourth annual locals' masquerade on the Thursday of Spooky Bear weekend at the Gifford House, this year themed around Spooky Bear. Free entry; guests are asked to come in their best masquerade look.
notes: Out x Out places it in Purgatory (basement club); ptownie just says Gifford House. End time from Out x Out only.

title: All Hallows Tea
description: Friday-afternoon Halloween tea at the Gifford House, listed on the ptownie calendar for 2–6 PM. It overlaps the Boatslip's Uniform Tea and the Ursamen Meet & Greet.
notes: Only seen on ptownie's calendar; event page not fetched, no other corroboration.

title: FAG BASH / Spooky Bear / Provincetown 2026
description: Father Figure's FAG BASH party lands in 'Ptown's spookiest basement' for Spooky Bear weekend, with music by Prosumer, Charlene and Father Figure and a performance by Tyler Ashley. Friday night at Purgatory under the Gifford House.
notes: Eventbrite price tiers not readable without JS. No refunds.
